title: test-coverage register row says done; on the round's tree 34 of 95 modules are below 95% (config_flow.py 99.21%)
claim: Under every default-gate test script, each traced on its own and combined (fast + e2e + stress, 25 scripts), 34 of 95 modules are below the Silver rule's 95% statement coverage. The lowest are duty_legs.py 31.78, heat_curve.py 38.28, repairs.py 44.12, disinfection.py 47.66 and services.py 56.06; the package is at 91.38%. config_flow.py is at 99.21% (8 statements missed) against config-flow-test-coverage's 100%. quality_scale.yaml marks both rows done (D10-criteria Q2/Q3).
mechanism: The register keys test-coverage to the recorded floors in tests/coverage_budgets.json (module_percent_floor 95.0, config_flow_percent_floor 100.0) rather than to a fresh measurement of the tree. On this tree 15 of the 25 measured scripts exit non-zero, tests/entities.py among them (it dies at import, see leads), and what a failing script leaves unexecuted is uncovered. Dropping entities alone moves only 34 -> 38 modules, so the shortfall is spread across the suite and not one crash.

evidence.unit: modules (of 95) below 95% statement coverage; package 91.38%; config_flow.py 99.21%
evidence.machine: macOS arm64 8-core (box B1, local), venv-ci Python 3.14.7, coverage installed into a private --target dir
evidence.contention_note: box saturated (load1 up to ~188 during the run). Line sets are contention-immune unless a script times out on load; the per-script exit codes are in the run's scripts.tsv
evidence.tolerance: exact for this tree and interpreter

instrumented_symbol: every module of custom_components/heatpump_optimizer as coverage.py traced it under tools/coverage/coverage_tree.sh's per-script runs

perturbation.change: cov_recombine.py <root> --drop features: the same union without tests/features.py's data (equivalent to COV_DROP=features in cov_modules.sh)

metric_definition: Count of package modules whose statement coverage over the union of all default-gate scripts' traced lines is below 95.0%.
phenomenon_property: Every integration module is above 95% statement coverage under the gate's own scripts on the tree being released, and config_flow.py at 100%. The register row is derived from that measurement, not from a recorded floor.

null_control.value: 34 modules below 95, package 91.38 (reproduces cov_modules.sh exactly); --drop entities 38, --drop config_flow_steps 43 with config_flow.py 80.20
null_control.note: the re-combination reproduces the direct run, and each dropped script moves only what it covers

proposed_fix_scope: Restore the failing gate scripts on the tree. Then cover the listed modules (heat_curve, duty_legs, repairs, disinfection, services first) or change the two register rows to todo with the measured figures, and have tests/entities.py key the rows to a fresh coverage run instead of the recorded floors.
